native_contract.group_info: Native computes the 8-byte kind-info row with unchecked 32-bit group_index*8; field+0x38 stores low WORD, field+0x58 stores record address minus row owner address. native_contract.worklist_row: Native binds actor to source row through the owner-relative byte offset; it does not append to the separate actor-worklist arrays.

field_notes: 0x270c0/0x27720 copy XYZ to actor+0/+4/+8 and +0x9c/+0xa0/+0xa4; 0x27c40 writes only the base XYZ fields.
0x270c0 copies record state WORD+0x0e to actor+0x2a; 0x27720 and 0x27c40 do not.

0x270c0/0x27720 set actor+0x94 to 0xff when record flags include 0x1000; the subsequent negated low-byte mask contributes actor+0x54 bit 0x10 for the same flag, plus actor+0x95 bit 0x20. The existing initializers currently zero actor+0x95.
All callbacks occur after initialization, marking, actor field binding, and selected asset reads; callback return values are discarded. Factory return is the allocated actor pointer.
The normal factory alone copies record state WORD+0x0e to actor+0x2a. Alternate leaves these family-specific flag fields at initializer state.
